gaps: P0–P2: none (#1 is a portrait of Ottavio Piccolomini, Duke of Amalfi); P5: none (Mittelholzer aerials show the coast toward Vietri, not the town)
notes: P3 alternative: #3, Carl Wagner’s pencil drawing of 1823 from near the Capuchin convent (only 22 years from #2, so not both). P4 alternative: #6, photochrom of the 1890s in color, but the town is small behind a woman on a pergola terrace; #8 is the clearer general view. #9 is the reverse of #8.
